html:
A full water tank takes 38 seconds to empty. Its volume VV litres at time tt seconds is changing at a rate dVdt=9t+13−7\frac{dV}{dt}=\sqrt[3]{9t+1}-7, 0≤t≤380\le t\le38.

  1. Determine the initial rate of change of volume. (1 mark)

  2. Use the increments formula to estimate the volume emptied during the first one-third of a second. (2 marks)

  3. Determine the initial volume. (3 marks)

  4. Determine the time, to the nearest 0.01 second, when it is half full. (3 marks)

html:
The concentration of a drug in a monkey’s plasma, CC micrograms per litre, tt hours after administration, is modelled by C=C0ektC=C_0e^{kt}. Each dose increases the existing concentration by 310 μg/L. The concentration halves every 3 hours and 40 minutes. A monkey with no existing trace is given its first dose at 8:45 am.

  1. Use the model to determine the rate of change of concentration later that day at 12:25 pm. (4 marks)

  2. An additional dose is given whenever concentration falls to 110 μg/L. Determine the expected time of day, to the nearest minute, of the third dose. (4 marks)
